oned [...] the

ited and

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [There is] a great ju[dgement; and] now also a ti[me existed] that they sculpt[ed the Great Spirit;] he was revealed in the Father, the first established thing.

Happen you know that the grains of the earth {particles} are measurable, [and those of] the [entire] universe. It is possible to count the {particles} of the earth each year [and] the sand grains of the entire universe; but the duration of the time that the Great Spirit spent in the Father, [the] first established thing, one will not be able to make a count of it!

He first sculpted her like this. He established her in his inner storehouses in quiet and silence. When [they had] need of her she was called and came forth of the Father [of Greatness]. She looked at all her aeons of light!

Once again, from the time when she was called to [come forth and] go to [the aeons,] she gave [her power] upon his [bod]y [and over] all the aeons [of light]; she also [encompassed] all of them. This [is also the case] with the First Man.

This is how the Man spent a long time being anointed in the Mother, set fast in her inner storehouses [in quiet and silence]; the extent of time that I have recounted to you—from when the First Man went down to the contest, till the time when the [Last Statue co]mes i[n to the light:] this time [is the duration of his anointing. Then] he appeared [and came forth.]

Again, from when he was called and came forth, till the time when he [himse]lf called the five shining [gods] who are his sons; they themselves also spent a long time existing in their father! It is the time that occurred from the coming down of the First Man till the going up of the Last Statue. The five gods spent this much duration being anointed in the First Man. Yet, [at the] time when they were awaited, they were called and came forth.

Listen also to this, how I would teach you it. At the time when the Mother of Life was called from the Father of Greatness, when she expelled herself and came down by her own wish, from the heights of the Father to the earth, [she would spend thousands of] years and many ten thousands until she reached the earth. [Fo]r there is no measure nor rule to the heights of the Father. Rather, [just as] he had called her in his Great Spirit, so he set her upon [the] land of greatness through one of these three that are counted to the twelve hidden ones within the light veil, the ones [esta]blished after the [great] region of the south.

[The] matter of the Mother [of L]ife is like this. When [the Father called her he established her in the place he pleased,] to establish her there as the instruction of the people that [would receive her] many [wisdoms]; and she examined everywhere that [she went in] a blink of an eye, or like a [swift] bird [in flight.]

Again, he too, the First Man, spent a long period and [time] until he gave power to his sons; until he assu[m]ed them. After he came to wear them he stood fast in the heights between the borders. Again, he spent a duration and time like this, corresponding to such amount and measure as the raindrops and dew and falls of mist that come down in the universe. This is how he spent this duration also, standing between the borders, until the hour when he cast himself down to the contest!

Whenever the Father of Greatn[e]ss called the Great Spirit and the First Man and the gods of the glorious one, who are provided to enable them to reveal him; at that very time [he] sculpted the Great Builder in the [land of] light, [and] the Living Spirit with the mighty and active gods who came [from] him. Also, at that time, he sculpted the [Amb]assador, with Jesus the Splendour and the Virgin of Light and the Pillar of Glory, and the gods who came from them. [All these the Father of Greatness sculpted at] a single time. They came forth of one another, one after one; the time when [they were called forth] and the work.

[From] that time when he sculpted these three [emanations,] till the time when the Father would unveil his face, [and they] go in to his hidden storehouses, and he calls them [and] establishes each one of them to his place. There is no measure nor rule to this period until that time.
[Now] he gives [an account] about this Matter, this thought of death[,] which I have told you; for [this] is the way that [it] came up to its storehouses. It has [its existence] in its five elements.

Again, it also [is like this:] the period and the time that it spent, until it revealed itself to its elements, before it came to the trees. It spent a great period and a long time established [in its own nature,] before it came up to the trees. It was [dwelling] in the trees. It spent a long time and duration [also] existing in them, before it sculpted the fru[its of its kind] and sculpted the fruits.
[The first is the contest, when] he came to be in some [peril, and] when they ensnared a [portion of the light.]
[The second is the construction,] that he built [the creation and] the universe was established. The zone [extends] down until the time when it will be dissolved.

The third is the [endurance, when all] the things and the universe will [endure,] from the time when they were established there, till the time when their end will be complete and their existence ceases[.]

However, [the da]rkness [is brought low,] and they take it in to the tomb [and seal it there,] and they are bound with it in an eternal chain.
